mostWorthwhile.text: Joining arteries to the capillary bed was most worthwhile: the planned branching illustration connects vessel structure to distribution across tissue.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the lining separately to each vessel type was somewhat repetitive, although the contrasting wall descriptions made the sequence useful.

surprise.text: The venous-return illustration showed contracting limb muscle helping move blood, with valves preventing backward flow; that made their role more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The capillary support sleeves’ pericytes were named in the opening illustration plan but their role was not explained in the result.

continue.text: I would continue: assembling the route made the structural differences and their functions clear, and I would be curious to see how circulation connects to other systems.
